BiblicalUsage: Jiphdejah is Iphedeiah, an Israelite, a son of Shashak of Benjamin. In 1 Chronicles 8:25, Iphedeiah, and Penuel.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Iphedeiah belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
